title: docs(site): objectstack.ai becomes the developer site — one-line positioning, start command, docs entry points, "Run it" strip; blog redirects to objectos.ai
body:
Fixes #26140

objectstack.ai is the developer site; www.objectos.ai is the product site and the one blog (maintainer ruling 2026-10-26, 「同意」「立卡派发」 13:24Z). This PR makes the landing read that way and sends the blog to the product site.

## What changed

**Landing (`apps/docs/app/[lang]/page.tsx`)** — the product hero (display headline, four-verb line, the 90-second video, the prose block, and the idea / loop / gates / vocabulary sections in full) is replaced by:

- the slogan as a kicker above one line of positioning: "ObjectStack is the open protocol and SDK that ObjectOS is built on: one typed business ontology, and the database, API, Console and MCP tools derive from it." — the page heading, the document title, the description, the Open Graph card and the JSON-LD headline all read the same two constants;
- the start command block: `npm create objectstack@latest my-app` · `cd my-app` · `npx os dev --ui` — the spelling `content/docs/getting-started` teaches;
- five docs entry points: Getting started (`/docs/getting-started`), Concepts (`/docs/concepts`), Spec (`/docs/protocol`), CLI (`/docs/deployment/cli`), Build with Claude Code (`/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code`) — every route exists under `content/docs`;
- the GitHub link;
- the former four sections shrunk to one four-link row into the docs pages that already carry that content: The idea → `/docs/concepts/ontology`; The loop → `/docs/getting-started/build-with-claude-code`; The gates → `/docs/getting-started/how-ai-development-works` (its "Why it's safe" section is the guardrail story); The vocabulary → `/docs/capabilities`. All four pages exist, so no section stays in compact form and no docs page was created;
- the "Run it" strip: ObjectOS Community (this repository's runtime image, self-hosted, free → `/docs/deployment/self-hosting`), ObjectOS Cloud and ObjectOS Enterprise (→ https://www.objectos.ai). It replaces the closing sentence "Rather build & ask online? Try ObjectOS";
- a footer line labelling the two sites by role: `objectstack.ai — Developer docs & protocol` · `www.objectos.ai — Product, editions & blog`. Both hosts are read from the constants that own them (`SITE_ORIGIN`, `PRODUCT_SITE_URL`), never spelled twice.

**Navigation (`apps/docs/lib/layout.shared.tsx`)** — the header gains `Product` (external, → https://www.objectos.ai) beside `Why` and `Blog`. `PRODUCT_SITE_URL` is exported for the landing; the origin itself is declared once, in `redirects.mjs` (the dependency-free module the redirect gate imports), and re-exported here.

**Blog redirects (`apps/docs/redirects.mjs`, the second commit, fb85c546)** — a `blogRedirects` table beside `docsRedirects`: `/blog` → `https://www.objectos.ai/en/blog/`, and each of the four posts (`context-window-is-the-constraint`, `metadata-driven-architecture`, `protocol-first-development`, `the-ontology-is-the-software`) at `/blog/SLUG` and at the prerendered `/en/blog/SLUG` → `https://www.objectos.ai/en/blog/SLUG/`, all permanent (308). A second table on purpose: `check:docs-redirects` resolves every `docsRedirects` destination against `content/docs` and reports an off-site destination as UNRESOLVABLE — right for a docs redirect, meaningless for a cross-site one. The `.mdx` sources under `content/blog` and the `app/[lang]/blog` route stay in the tree; removing them is the follow-up once the redirects are measured on production.

**Removed** — `apps/docs/components/youtube-embed.tsx`: its only consumer was the retired hero.

### Sequencing — this PR lands after www.objectos.ai#286

The redirect commit points at the posts www.objectos.ai#286 imports under the same slugs at `/en/blog/SLUG/`. The seat lands this PR after that import is live on the product site, so no redirect ever answers into a 404. Until then the posts stay served here, and nothing in this PR needs to land before #286.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## How it was verified

All readings on head `fb85c546` (the final commit; nothing was pushed after the union ran). The live sites are not reachable from this container, so every reading is source-level or against the locally built app.

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/docs^...' build` (the closure: `@objectstack/spec`) under the verify lock — `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs typecheck` (`fumadocs-mdx && next typegen && tsc --noEmit`) under the lock — `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs build` (= `pnpm docs:build`: `gen:schema`, `gen:docs`, `gen:upgrade-guide`, `build-llms-full`, `next build`) under the lock — `✓ Compiled successfully in 3.8min`, `✓ Generating static pages using 2 workers (1287/1287) in 68s`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`; `git status` clean afterwards.
- The built app served with `next start` on a random port and probed with curl (status + redirect URL):
  - `/blog` → `308 https://www.objectos.ai/en/blog/`
  - `/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software` → `308 https://www.objectos.ai/en/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software/`
  - `/en/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software` → `308 https://www.objectos.ai/en/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software/` (no 307 hop through the locale proxy: `redirects()` runs before it)
  - the other three posts and `/en/blog` → 308 to their counterparts; `/blog/not-a-post` → 404 (unchanged); `/docs/guides/cheatsheets/quick-reference` → 308 to `/docs/getting-started/quick-reference` (an existing docs redirect, unchanged)
  - `.next/routes-manifest.json` carries 10 redirects whose destination names `objectos.ai`
  - `/` renders the positioning sentence (heading, title, description, Open Graph, JSON-LD), the three start commands, the five entry points, the four-link row, `ObjectOS Community` / `ObjectOS Cloud` / `ObjectOS Enterprise` under "Run it", the `Product` nav entry and the two role labels — each confirmed by `grep -c` on the served HTML; the document title reads `The open protocol and SDK ObjectOS is built on | ObjectStack`
  - the server was stopped by its recorded PID; the port probe afterwards answered nothing.
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config` on the three edited files — exit 0.
- Derived gate subset (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 31 commands) run with each exit code captured before any pipe — all 31 exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: `31 derived, 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. Among them `pnpm check:docs-redirects` (`98 entries … 0 outside the /docs route space`), `pnpm check:published-readme-links`, `pnpm check:docs-locale-catch-all`, `check-docs-nav-label`, `check-doc-frontmatter`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`.
- CI families not re-run locally, read from this PR's check-runs: `pnpm lint` (repo-wide eslint, inside `Lint & Repo Gates`), `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core`, `Test Core`, `Check Documentation Links` (lychee over `content/**`), and the docs production-build job in `ci.yml` (its `apps/docs/**` path filter fires on this diff).

## Acceptance notes

- No changeset: `apps/docs` is private and nothing under a published package's `files[]` moved — `skip-changeset` is declared on this PR.
- The header's `Why` and `Blog` entries stay site-relative (`/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software`, `/blog`); after this PR they resolve through the new redirects to the product site's blog. Re-pointing or dropping them belongs to the follow-up that deletes the blog route and sources.
- `app/sitemap.ts` still lists `/blog` and the four posts (it derives them from the `blog` loader); once the redirects are live those entries point at redirecting URLs. They disappear with the same follow-up (the loader's collection goes with `content/blog`); `sitemap.ts` is outside this card's file surface and is not touched here.
- Four in-content links to `/blog/...` (`content/blog/metadata-driven-architecture.mdx:9`, `content/blog/protocol-first-development.mdx:9`, `content/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software.mdx:124`, `content/docs/concepts/compare.mdx:124`) are relative links to redirected pages — they keep working through the redirect; none is an in-page embed. Docs content is out of scope here.
- `HERO_COVER.alt` (`lib/site.ts`) still reads the slogan; the cover remains the site's Open Graph image, which the ruling keeps ("the slogan lives on").
- `apps/docs/app/[lang]/layout.tsx` carries a `cn: '中文'` entry in `LANGUAGE_NAMES` with no such locale declared in `lib/i18n.ts` — pre-existing dead entry, observation only, not touched.
- The two hosted-edition descriptions (Cloud, Enterprise) are one neutral sentence each and link to the product site root; the product site's edition pages (www.objectos.ai#286, objectos#338) own the detail, and #26136 owns the hosted product's name — nothing here pins a name beyond the three edition labels the ruling gives.
- Commit trailers follow the repository's model-free pair (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, enforced by the pre-push hook): both commits were reworded before their first push; no published history was rewritten.
